propositions: The query ticket digest is re-sent verbatim in every overlap-judge call's user message, incurring full token cost each time despite being invariant across a batch.
Moving the query digest from the volatile user message into the cacheable system prompt allows the shared bytes to be cached (1 write + N-1 reads) rather than billed in full N times.

The measured stable prefix (846 tokens) falls short of the actual minimum cacheable prefix for claude-sonnet-4-6 (1024 tokens), resulting in zero cache hits and a +5.8% token regression despite the structural change.

Judgment precision is preserved on all 12 ordered pairs (before/after relation verdicts identical; confidence variance within sampling bounds), confirming the pointer-for-inline substitution does not degrade accuracy.
The hoisted design establishes a measured baseline (prefix size vs. model floor) needed to evaluate call-batching or retrieval-tightening as the next lever to close the 149-296 token gap.
